**Texas Tech K-12 Tuition-Free vs. Tuition-Paid Programs**

---

**Tuition-Free Program (Texas Residents Only)**

- **Eligibility:**
  - Only available to full-time Texas residents under age 25.
  - Requires proof of Texas residency (e.g., deed, lease, utility bill, military documents).
  - Must withdraw from local school district to attend full-time.
  - Enrollment is limited and determined by a lottery system each semester.

- **Cost:**
  - No tuition or course fees for eligible students.
  - Required textbooks are provided at no cost.
  - Families are responsible for providing a computer, internet access, and general school supplies.

- **Requirements:**
  - Must be enrolled in at least four semester courses at all times.
  - Must make weekly progress: work in each course at least three days per week and complete at least 5% of assignments per course per week.
  - Must complete each course within six months.
  - Participation in all required State of Texas Assessments of Academic Readiness (STAAR) and End-of-Course (EOC) exams is mandatory.
  - Attendance and academic progress are closely monitored; failure to meet requirements may result in removal from the program.

- **Enrollment Periods:**
  - Applications accepted during designated periods; lottery held if applications exceed capacity.
  - Automatic re-enrollment for current students who submit a re-enrollment form.

- **More Information:**
  - [Tuition-Free Program Details](https://www.depts.ttu.edu/k12/freetuition/)
  - [Requirements](https://www.depts.ttu.edu/k12/freetuition/requirements/)

---

**Tuition-Paid Program (Texas & Non-Texas Residents)**

- **Eligibility:**
  - Open to students outside Texas or Texas residents who want more flexibility or do not meet tuition-free requirements.
  - No lottery; open enrollment year-round as long as space is available.

- **Cost:**
  - $200 admission fee (non-refundable).
  - $300 per course (TX/US); $450 per course (International).
  - $80 per online Credit by Exam (CBE).
  - Additional fees for print materials, transcripts, overnight shipping, etc.
  - Students are responsible for purchasing their own textbooks and materials (except where provided within the course).

- **Requirements:**
  - Flexible course load; students may enroll in as many or as few courses as needed.
  - Six months to complete each course.
  - No mandatory state testing unless required for graduation or by the student’s local school.
  - Attendance and progress are monitored, but requirements are less restrictive than the tuition-free program.

- **Enrollment Periods:**
  - Open enrollment—students can start at any time.

- **More Information:**
  - [Tuition-Paid Program Details](https://www.depts.ttu.edu/k12/paid-tuition/)
  - [Tuition & Fees](https://www.depts.ttu.edu/k12/about/fees/)

---

**Key Differences**

- **Eligibility:** Tuition-free is only for Texas residents and uses a lottery; tuition-paid is open to all.
- **Cost:** Tuition-free has no tuition or course fees; tuition-paid requires payment per course and additional fees.
- **Enrollment:** Tuition-free has set periods and limited spots; tuition-paid is open year-round.
- **Requirements:** Tuition-free has strict attendance, progress, and state testing requirements; tuition-paid is more flexible.
- **Textbooks:** Tuition-free students receive textbooks at no cost; tuition-paid students purchase their own.

---

**Credit Recovery with Texas Tech K-12**

---

**Overview**
- Texas Tech K-12 offers credit recovery options for students who need to make up failed or incomplete courses to stay on track for graduation.
- Credit recovery can be accomplished by enrolling in individual online courses or by taking Credit by Exams (CBEs) to demonstrate mastery of the required material.

---

**Steps for Credit Recovery**

1. **Consult Your School Counselor or Advisor**
   - If you are a full-time Texas Tech K-12 student, contact your Texas Tech K-12 academic advisor.
   - If you attend another school, speak with your local school counselor to confirm which courses or CBEs are needed and to ensure your school will accept the credit.

2. **Choose the Appropriate Option**
   - **Online Courses:** Enroll in the course you need to recover credit for. You will have six months to complete the course.
   - **Credit by Exam (CBE):** Take a CBE to demonstrate mastery and earn credit without completing the full course. CBEs are available for many subjects and grade levels.

3. **Get Approval**
   - Obtain approval from your school counselor or advisor before enrolling in a course or CBE to ensure the credit will be accepted and applied to your transcript.
